## About

A learning resource for mathematical psychology, covering textbook chapters, research articles, and topic explorations.

## Content

| Section | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [Lectures](lectures/) | Slide presentations with key concepts and derivations |
| [Demos](demos/) | R code demonstrations showing models in action |
| [Exercises](exercises/) | Practice problems (conceptual, math, coding, applied) with solutions |

## How to Use

1. Read the original source material (PDFs not included due to copyright)
2. Use lectures for concept review
3. Run demos to see models in action
4. Practice and test yourself with exercises
